payload.storylineSummary: A college student demonstrates a bold and provocative cold-calling strategy to sell websites. He starts by insulting a prospect's current site to capture their attention, navigates through their hostile yet intrigued reaction, successfully secures an in-person meeting, and concludes by revealing the AI tool he uses to rapidly build the professional websites he pitches.
